(SUM(CASE WHEN <x> + <y> IS NOT NULL THEN <x>*<y> END)
  -
  SUM(CASE WHEN <x> + <y> IS NOT NULL THEN <x> END)
  *
  SUM(CASE WHEN <x> + <y> IS NOT NULL THEN <y> END)
  /
  NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN <x> + <y> IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0)
)
/
NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN <x> + <y> IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0)

COUNT(CASE WHEN <x> + <y> IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)

CAST(SUM(IIF(<x> + <y> IS NOT NULL, <x> * <y>, 0)) - SUM(IIF(<x> + <y> IS NOT NULL, <y>, 0)) * SUM(IIF(<x> + <y> IS NOT NULL, <x>, 0)) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(IIF(<x> + <y> IS NOT NULL, 1, NULL))
